sections.label: Our Teams

briefs.headline: Chelsea sell Enzo Fernandez to Man City for £125M on deadline day
briefs.summary: The midfielder's move headlined the window's close Tuesday; Chelsea also let Marc Guiu go to RB Leipzig for £14.6M and loaned keeper Robert Sanchez to Como.

briefs.headline: Spurs raid Chelsea for Adarabioyo and Mudryk before the deadline
briefs.summary: Tottenham, bottom of the table with no points from two matches, paid £10M for the defender and took the winger on loan; Kevin Danso and Pape Matar Sarr left on loans of their own.

briefs.headline: Reds edge the Padres 4-3 on Trevino's bases-loaded single
briefs.summary: Jose Trevino's eighth-inning hit scored Elly De La Cruz with the go-ahead run Tuesday; Nick Lodolo gave two earned over six, and Fernando Tatis Jr. homered twice for San Diego.

briefs.headline: Pirates outlast the Giants 13-12 on a walk-off error
briefs.summary: Pittsburgh scored nine in the third, watched San Francisco tie it with a five-run eighth, and won Tuesday when a short-hopped throw let Brandon Lowe score; Lowe went 4-for-6 with his 29th homer.

briefs.headline: Marshall men draw 3-3 at George Mason to close the road swing
briefs.summary: The Herd finished the trip Tuesday night in Fairfax unbeaten at 1-0-2; George Mason's own game log carries the final, with the Patriots now 1-1-1.

sections.label: Around the Leagues

briefs.headline: Aki basho dates are official at last: Sept. 13 to 27 in Tokyo
briefs.summary: The Kokugikan's own schedule page carries the dates the JSA's English site never posted, ending 19 mornings of second-Sunday arithmetic; the basho opens 11 days from today, every Tokyo session sold out.

briefs.headline: Hoshoryu back in training a month after knee surgery
briefs.summary: The French sumo site Furansumo reported Tuesday, from Tatsunami stable's own posts, that the new west yokozuna has resumed shiko in a knee brace, down 15 kg to 148; its read is he likely sits out Aki, and no entry decision is announced.

sections.note: r/Sumo is now refused outright, an eleventh straight morning without it, and the JSA's English schedule pages still error out - the Kokugikan's calendar is the citable source going forward.

coming_in.item: Proclamation PA-42-2026 reopened rainfall-closed portions of Topsail Sound, Chadwick Bay and nearby waters to shellfish harvest at sunrise this morning.

prime.item: Day two of the two-week window: one fish per day, 15-inch minimum, and harvest reporting is mandatory under proclamation FF-27-2026.
September is bull-drum time on the coast; coastal-water limits hold at an 18-to-27-inch slot, one per day, with harvest reporting required.

going_out.item: The first gun window, in SELECTED COUNTIES only, closes Monday; the county list is not in the pamphlet's summary table, so none is named here.

sections.note: The DNR's separate migratory-bird summary is still untranscribed here; WV Explorer reports the first dove segment opened Sept. 1, HIP registration required. NCDMF opened a kingfishes (sea mullet) scoping period through Sept. 30, with a Wilmington meeting Sept. 17.

waters.working: Down from 128 a day ago and the thinnest of the week - pool-and-drop pocket water now, so fish it like September: a long leader off the rod tip, one beetle or ant tight under the overhangs, and a small sculpin swung through the two or three bends still holding depth.

waters.near: 14 miles above R.C. Byrd Locks and Dam
waters.read: 25.1 ft - normal pool. Ordinary bank access.
waters.working: Pool has not moved in a day - the wing-dam tips are still the morning spot, a white swimbait over shad early, then a dragged jig on the seams when the sun gets on the water.

waters.near: below R.C. Byrd Locks and Dam
waters.read: 25.6 ft - normal pool. Ordinary bank access.
waters.working: Steady below the dam - crawfish colors tight to the riprap and the lock wall, and a jig pitched into the barge cuts where fish hold off the current.

waters.reading: Sound highs 12:22 AM at 3.5 ft and 1:01 PM at 4.1 ft at Hampstead; lows 6:43 AM at 0.4 ft and 7:42 PM at 0.9 ft.
waters.read: Fish the moving water either side of high at 12:22 AM and 1:01 PM in the sound.
waters.working: The September report is finally fresh - Fisherman's Post published its Topsail monthly yesterday: Spanish and blues on Gotchas off the piers, reds on topwater early inshore, and flounder now legal against pilings and creek mouths. Flounder want moving water on structure, so work the flood into the 1:01 PM high; reds want the last of the fall, into tonight's 7:42 low. Waning gibbous at 71%, springs easing toward neap. Water 85.3F at Beaufort, 60 miles up the coast.
waters.note: Hampstead is the sound station and the read that matters; the oceanfront pier runs well ahead and is quoted only for a surf read. No beach hazards or rip current statements posted for Topsail this morning - the day's Heat Advisory covers inland Pender and Onslow, not the island.

kicker: The Aki basho's dates reached citable print at last; whether its newest yokozuna can enter is the question that remains.
